display_long_description:
This is a demo showcase of Places, a platform built for professional teams designing real-world spaces and products. 

From store layouts and packaging to facility planning and merchandising, Places shows how teams can visualize, test, and align ideas before anything is built.

Traditional tools like CAD, PowerPoint, or screenshots make it hard for non-technical stakeholders to understand true scale and flow. With Places, everyone can step inside the same virtual environment, explore designs at life size, and make decisions as if they were there together. 

This leads to a more streamlined communication with internal and external stakeholders, less rework and a faster time to market.

Whether you’re designing the perfect store, testing a new product packaging, or walking stakeholders through a facility plan, Places brings clarity and confidence to every stage of the process.

Key Features
Real-time multi-user collaboration
Grab, move, interact with just hands, like you do in real life
Realistic physics and lighting
Frame-based A/B testing
Heatmapping for consumer insight
Presentation mode to walk executives through your ideas
Enterprise-grade security (SOC 2 Type II)


Places transforms how organizations design the physical world: faster alignment, smarter decisions, and fewer expensive mistakes.
